set1_clu_composes_rivals_fail.rule: CLU n_valid == n_requests AND every rival + floor n_valid == 0 (seed 0); first '-hh' pair sub-corner, first n-way corner

set2_all_arms_succeed.rule: every arm incl. the continuous MLP n_valid > 0 in the SAME seed (necessary, not sufficient); request-level co-validity decided at render
set2_all_arms_succeed.render_rule: render scans EVERY held-out corner (pair first, then n-way, scorer order) for requests valid in all six columns; if there are none, the all-six set is DECLARED NOT BUILDABLE with the count and the figure shows the nearest pattern (every column except the continuous MLP), one request per corner, first 4

set3_all_arms_fail.rule: every rival + floor n_valid == 0 AND CLU n_valid < n_requests (seed 0), lowest CLU fraction first

selection.within_corner_rule: the corner's requests in the scorer's own order (fw._request_values_from_rows over the corner's rows); the first REQUESTS_PER_CORNER that meet the set's verdict pattern

declared.set2_all_six: DECLARED NOT BUILDABLE: 0 of 5688 held-out requests at seed 0 are valid for every column (all six arms). Shown instead: the nearest pattern, every arm EXCEPT the continuous MLP valid, with its cross shown. Seeds 1 and 2 were scanned too (diag/covalid_scan.json): 0 all-six there either.
declared.set2_pattern_shown: every column valid EXCEPT the continuous MLP (all-six set is empty)
